vectors.name: ask_for_settings
vectors.why: An agent asks for exact settings and a contact, signed by its own key.

vectors.name: ask_for_controls
vectors.why: An agent whose person hasn't set up controls yet asks them to set them up for it, naming its Signet's delegate key for the delegation signed with them.

vectors.name: controls_naming_no_delegate
vectors.why: Controls name the key their delegation goes to.

vectors.name: controls_naming_a_key_that_isnt_one
vectors.why: The delegate is a real key, in its one spelling.

vectors.name: ask_for_a_held_step
vectors.why: An agent asks its person to say yes to one step held for them.

vectors.name: step_with_a_setting
vectors.why: A step changes no rule, so it's alone in its ask, and the yes signed is to it alone.

vectors.name: step_naming_no_request
vectors.why: A step names its request by ID.

vectors.name: step_of_an_unknown_kind
vectors.why: Only a step an owner can say yes to.

vectors.name: ask_by_filter
vectors.why: Owners named, and people it has dealt with, may reach it for a quote.

vectors.name: contact_with_a_type_by_name_alone
vectors.why: An owner names a type two agents agreed by its ID, with its schema's fingerprint, and never one of core's own.

vectors.name: contact_with_a_type_of_cores_own
vectors.why: An owner names a type two agents agreed by its ID, with its schema's fingerprint, and never one of core's own.

vectors.name: ask_for_where_paid
vectors.why: An agent asks its person to sign where they get paid: exactly these places, as a statement would hold them.

vectors.name: where_paid_with_a_setting
vectors.why: Where the owner gets paid changes no rule, so it's alone in its ask.

vectors.name: where_paid_at_a_page_with_a_login
vectors.why: Every place is one a statement takes, so no login rides on a payment page.

vectors.name: where_paid_at_one_place_twice
vectors.why: Each place once.

vectors.name: where_paid_past_what_a_statement_holds
vectors.why: Four places that each fit, but not in one statement of at most 1,536 bytes, which the owner could never sign.

vectors.name: ask_to_move_host
vectors.why: An agent asks its person to move it to another host under the same ID: the owner's side signs a binding at that address.

vectors.name: move_with_a_setting
vectors.why: A move changes no rule, so it's alone in its ask.

vectors.name: move_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: The address moved to has one spelling, as everywhere.

vectors.name: move_to_no_address
vectors.why: A move names a whole address.

vectors.name: move_with_a_vouch
vectors.why: A move carries nothing but where to: the owner's side signs with what it already holds.

vectors.name: ask_for_controls_with_an_owner_part
vectors.why: An agent asks its person to set up controls with their name after its handle, as they gave it: the owner's side signs its binding at that name.

vectors.name: controls_with_an_owner_part_that_isnt_a_handle
vectors.why: An owner part is one handle: no dot, tilde or capitals.

vectors.name: controls_with_no_owner_part_written_out
vectors.why: An owner part left out is left out, so an ask has one spelling.

vectors.name: ask_to_add_an_owner_part
vectors.why: An agent its person set up with no owner part asks them to add theirs, once: the owner's side signs a binding at its name with that part after its handle.

vectors.name: owner_part_with_a_setting
vectors.why: An owner part changes no rule, so it's alone in its ask.

vectors.name: owner_part_that_isnt_a_handle
vectors.why: An owner part is one handle, never a whole address.

vectors.name: ask_ended
vectors.why: An ask nobody approved is over at its end.

vectors.name: ask_from_the_future
vectors.why: A clock far ahead can't make an ask that lasts longer.

vectors.name: ask_signed_by_another_key
vectors.why: Only the asking agent's key signs its ask.

vectors.name: ask_naming_another_agent
vectors.why: An ask is from the agent whose key signed it.

vectors.name: ask_by_an_owners_id
vectors.why: An owner's ID, which carries key statements, is never an agent's, so it signs no ask, even one naming that ID and signed by the key that counts.

vectors.name: ask_by_a_passkey_owners_id
vectors.why: An ID whose key is a passkey is an owner's, never an agent's, so it signs no ask, even with ES256 over an ask naming it.

vectors.name: two_changes_to_one_setting
vectors.why: An ask says one thing about each setting, so what's shown is what's signed.

vectors.name: two_changes_to_one_contact
vectors.why: And one thing about each contact.

vectors.name: no_changes
vectors.why: An ask asks for something.

vectors.name: ask_lasting_more_than_a_day
vectors.why: An ask lasts a day at most.

vectors.name: change_with_a_note
vectors.why: A change carries no words of the agent's: it explains in its own chat.

vectors.name: unknown_change
vectors.why: Only the changes the protocol names, so a sign-in or recovery is never askable.

vectors.name: open_to_no_types
vectors.why: Open to anyone names what for.

vectors.name: contacts_with_types
vectors.why: Contacts only lets nobody else in, for any type.

vectors.name: past_false_written_out
vectors.why: A field left at its default is left out, so an ask has one spelling.

vectors.name: contact_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: An address has one spelling, as everywhere.

vectors.name: id_in_capitals
vectors.why: An ask's ID is 32 lowercase hex digits.

vectors.name: ask_of_another_version
vectors.why: Only version 1.

vectors.name: ask_ending_as_it_starts
vectors.why: An ask lasts some time.

vectors.name: ask_for_a_guests_owner
vectors.why: A guest has no owner to ask, and its ID is never one.

vectors.name: ask_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: An ask has one spelling, so nothing rides beside the changes shown.

vectors.name: open_naming_owners
vectors.why: Open to anyone names no owners: those are a filter's.

vectors.name: filter_naming_nobody
vectors.why: A filter names owners, or people it has dealt with, or both.

vectors.name: filter_naming_an_address
vectors.why: A filter names owners by ID.

vectors.name: filter_naming_a_guest
vectors.why: A guest is never an owner a filter names.

vectors.name: filter_with_no_owners_written_out
vectors.why: A list left empty is left out, so an ask has one spelling.

vectors.name: reach_to_an_unknown_kind
vectors.why: Only contacts, open or a filter.

vectors.name: reach_for_a_type_by_name_alone
vectors.why: Reach names agreed types by ID, as contacts do.

vectors.name: contact_that_is_a_guest
vectors.why: A contact is an agent, never a guest.

vectors.name: removing_a_guest
vectors.why: So is a contact removed.

vectors.name: contact_words_not_a_yes_or_no
vectors.why: Whether words are let in is true or false.

vectors.name: paused_not_a_yes_or_no
vectors.why: Paused is true or false.

vectors.name: level_of_an_unknown_kind
vectors.why: Only the levels the protocol names.

vectors.name: quoted_prices_of_an_unknown_kind
vectors.why: Only wait or within limits.

vectors.name: writes_to_an_unknown_kind
vectors.why: Only contacts or replies.

vectors.name: where_paid_at_no_place
vectors.why: Where the owner gets paid names a place.

vectors.name: where_paid_at_five_places
vectors.why: At most four, as a statement holds.

vectors.name: controls_naming_a_key_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: The delegate key in its one spelling, so the key shown is the key signed for.

vectors.name: controls_naming_a_point_off_the_curve
vectors.why: The delegate is a point on P-256.

vectors.name: ask_too_long
vectors.why: However many changes, an ask is short enough for a person to read: 16 KiB at most.

vectors.name: answer_to_an_ask
vectors.why: An owner the agent's link reached answers its ask for controls: kept where the ask's ID says, with a MAC by the ID over their owner ID.

vectors.name: answer_by_a_stranger
vectors.why: Someone who knows only the agent's address and key never saw the ask, so their MAC is by another ID.

vectors.name: answer_moved_to_another_owner
vectors.why: A MAC copied from another owner's answer says that owner answered, not this one.

vectors.name: mac_keyed_by_the_id_as_text
vectors.why: The key is the ID's 16 bytes, not its 32 hex digits.

vectors.name: mac_in_capitals
vectors.why: A MAC is 64 lowercase hex digits.

vectors.name: no_mac
vectors.why: An answer with no MAC is nobody's answer to the ask.

vectors.name: ask_id_in_capitals
vectors.why: An ask's ID is 32 lowercase hex digits.

vectors.name: move_reply
vectors.why: The owner approved this agent at this address, on the host keeping it.

vectors.name: move_reply_for_another_agent
vectors.why: An approval is for the agent it names.

vectors.name: move_reply_for_another_owner
vectors.why: The agent takes one only from its own owner.

vectors.name: move_reply_at_another_host
vectors.why: A host keeps only a move to itself.

vectors.name: move_reply_by_another_owner
vectors.why: Mallory can sign for Ana's agent, and Ana's agent's backup never vouched for her.

vectors.name: move_reply_with_no_vouch
vectors.why: The agent's backup has to vouch for the owner.

vectors.name: move_reply_with_another_field
vectors.why: A reply has one shape.

vectors.name: move_reply_of_another_version
vectors.why: Only the version the protocol names.
